newsitem.title: UK: Russia's Novorossiik port still shut but loading.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Novorossiik port still shut but loading.

text.p: Russia's key Black Sea oil port of Novorossiisk remained shut on Thursday morning after closing early Wednesday because of high winds and swell, a shipping source said.
But loadings of both crude oil and refined products were continuing and weather conditions were expected to improve later in the day, the source added.
"The port can be declared closed if the weather is such that vessels may not be able to berth," said the source.
The port, which is the main outlet for Russian crude to southern European refineries, closed at 0430 (local time) on Wednesday because of high winds.
Three vessels were alongside, the Cloud having sailed early Thursday after taking on some 80,000 tonnes of Urals crude.
Five crude tankers were at anchor waiting to berth.
